SELECT ((billing_day_mod30 - (140 % 30) + 30) % 30) as days_ahead,
       COUNT(*) as subs,
       SUM(seat_count) as seats,
       ROUND(SUM(seat_count * effective_price), 2) as renewal_rev

WHERE status = 'subscribed'
GROUP BY days_ahead
ORDER BY days_ahead
"

)
SELECT c.group_id, et.day as agent_turn_day, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM enterprise_turns et
JOIN thread_state ts ON et.thread_id = ts.thread_id AND et.turn_number = ts.max_turn

WHERE et.sender = 'agent'
GROUP BY c.group_id, et.day
ORDER BY et.day, c.group_id
"
